extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors and users attempting to locate or create an article (especially new editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users on locating, creating, or troubleshooting a missing Wikipedia article (e.g., steps to find alternative titles, account requirements, and next actions if a page is deleted or not visible).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a procedural requirement for creating articles on Wikipedia; if you are not autoconfirmed you cannot create a new article directly. See alternatives below (article wizard, draft submission, request a new article).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard / submit a draft / request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Options for users who cannot or should not create a live article immediately: the article wizard helps format and prepare a draft; submitting a draft allows review before creation; requesting a new article is another route to get an article created.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for "Last Week Tonight 2025" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check for similar or differently titled articles that already cover the topic (different spellings, numbering, or naming conventions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding inbound links can reveal existing coverage or redirects that use a different title; use link searches to discover related pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created pages may not be visible immediately (database delay / purge)
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you or someone else just created the page and you cannot see it, wait briefly or use the purge function to refresh the page cache before taking other actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and adding redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check capitalization variants of the title (beyond the first character) and create redirects from common alternate capitalizations to the canonical article to improve discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if the page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a missing page was deleted, consult the deletion log and help pages to learn the reason and whether the content can be restored or reworked to meet guidelines.
